resources.string: Foto TV asks Google for read-only access to the photos and albums that YOU choose in Google Photos (Photos Picker). It cannot see the rest of your library.
The photos you choose are saved only on this TV and shown here. Your sign-in token is stored encrypted on this TV.
Your data is not shared, sold, used for ads or to train AI models, and nothing is sent to servers run by the developer.
You can delete everything at any time with Clear and Disconnect account, and revoke access in your Google Account.
The use of information received from Photos APIs will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.
